Every heading below carries the attribute shown above it.

```markdown
## Pushed down one level {offset-headings-by="1"}

### Carried along by the cascade
```

## Pushed down one level {offset-headings-by="1"}

### Carried along by the cascade

The cascade is on by default; `offset-headings-recursive="false"` limits an offset to the heading carrying it.

## Capped before it gets there {offset-headings-by="3" offset-headings-max-level="4"}

Two plus three is five, and `offset-headings-max-level` holds it at four.

## Pulled up a level {offset-headings-by="-1"}

A negative offset pulls a heading towards the top of the document.

Set `extensions.offset-headings.by` to shift every heading at once; the two add together.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-offset-headings/>.
